prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: wide 3:1 ecommerce Shop Bags category banner
Primary request: A refined studio product scene showing a cream canvas tote bag with navy handles and a navy backpack, arranged on pale blue-grey studio plinths.
Input images: Image 1: visual reference for the existing category-banner palette, soft studio light, and open pale-blue space on the left. Image 2: product reference for the tote's cream canvas and navy handles and the backpack's navy fabric and silhouette.
Scene/backdrop: clean pale blue and light-grey seamless studio backdrop with two low pale blue-grey display plinths.
Subject: one cream canvas tote bag with dark navy shoulder handles and one structured navy backpack, both unbranded and neatly shaped.
Style/medium: polished, realistic ecommerce studio photography consistent with the site's existing pale blue, navy, cream and white category banners.
Composition/framing: very wide horizontal 3:1 panoramic banner; keep the entire left half calm, light, unobtrusive negative space for a heading. Arrange both bags on the right half, with the tote slightly forward and the backpack just behind it; show both bags fully with clear separation and comfortable margins.
Lighting/mood: soft broad studio light with subtle contact shadows, airy and understated.
Color palette: pale powder blue and cool light grey background/plinths, cream canvas tote, deep navy handles and backpack.
Materials/textures: believable woven canvas, matte navy webbing and softly textured backpack fabric.
Constraints: no people, no text, no logos, no labels, no shoes, no additional products, no watermark. Preserve the tote and backpack identities from the product reference.
